svg.aria-label: Two runtimes answering the same conversation: on the left the pipeline, four typed pydantic-ai agents in sequence on deepseek-v4-flash, triage, preprocess, retriever, calculator; on the right one Claude Agent SDK session on claude-sonnet-5 holding one system prompt distilled from those four and the same six calculator tools. A dashed arrow labelled distil runs from the four prompts to the one.
svg.title: Four agents, or one session with the same six tools

g.title: runtime "pipeline" — src/convfinqa/pipeline/runner.py: four pydantic-ai agents with typed outputs, each loading its own prompt lineage; v8 is the composition t2.p2.r5.c2
triage — classifies the turn (number or program) and the conversation type; prompt lineage t2
preprocess — resolves references against history and writes the sub-questions and the program; prompt lineage p2
retriever — pulls the operands out of the report's text and table; the one agent v8 changed, r5
calculator — executes the program through six explicit tools: add, subtract, multiply, divide, exp, greater; prompt lineage c2
four prompts, about 22k characters between them, on deepseek-v4-flash for every turn

runtime "agent_sdk" — src/convfinqa/backends/agent_sdk.py: one ClaudeSDKClient session per conversation; the report arrives in message one, every later question is one more message; the six calculator functions are its only tools, served over MCP
one Claude session — a single system prompt of about 16k characters, seven sections, distilled from v8's four by the teacher: keep the knowledge, drop the hand-off plumbing
the same six calculator tools: add, subtract, multiply, divide, exp, greater — arithmetic never happens in free text in either runtime
on claude-sonnet-5 through the Claude Agent SDK, on subscription billing, one CLI subprocess per conversation
sdk-distil — evalloop/sdk_teacher.py: the teacher reads the four v8 prompts and writes sdk_v1; the sdk_v* lineage starts here and is only ever edited by the loop
